headline.purpose: Trainer section headings and the empty-state title.

title.purpose: Exercise card titles and the "von N erledigt" progress tail; category headings use 800 at this size.

body.purpose: Descriptions and form text; tabular numerals.

numeral.purpose: The done count in the student progress card.

label.purpose: Nav links, counts, status lines, badges.

shadows.name: play-disc

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Exits; always shorter than the matching entrance (utility ease-exit).

motion.name: ease-move
motion.purpose: On-screen moves, e.g. the check-off morph group (utility ease-move).

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button background, color, shadow and 1px press transform.

motion.name: checkoff-morph
motion.value: view-transition group 380ms ease-move; new snapshot opaque (no fade, mix-blend normal); old snapshot fades 120ms; lift z-index 2, headings z-index 1; root crossfade 180ms
motion.purpose: Exercise card <-> done row via React <ViewTransition> (share "morph lift"); category headings named so they travel. Off under reduced motion (old snapshot hidden).

motion.name: celebrate-swap
motion.value: view-transition group 380ms ease-move; old fades 160ms ease-exit; new pops from scale 0.94, 420ms ease-enter, 120ms delay
motion.purpose: Progress card <-> all-done card (share "celebrate" / "progress-swap"); off under reduced motion.

motion.name: celebrate-burst
motion.value: one 4px ring, scale 1 -> 1.9, opacity 0.7 -> 0, 700ms ease-enter, 380ms delay
motion.purpose: All-done disc, only right after a real tick (never on load); hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: "Nächste Übung" scroll; auto under reduced motion.

motion.name: details-open
motion.purpose: Done row open/close where interpolate-size is supported; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: again-label
motion.purpose: "Nochmal ansehen" fades out while the row is open.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar fill growth; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: done-check
motion.purpose: Check icon entering the 28px disc of the "Erledigt" status; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Progress toast entry after the morph lands; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: toast-out
motion.purpose: Progress toast exit after 6s with the "Nächste Übung" button (3.7s without), held while hovered or focused; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: poster-fade
motion.purpose: Video thumbnail fades in on load; the player fades in 300ms after the tap.

motion.name: play-disc
motion.purpose: Video poster play disc; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: chevron
motion.purpose: Finished-row chevron on open; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading placeholders; off under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
A friendly, category-standard learning app built to the craft bar of the best consumer learning products. Every screen is a stack of soft white cards on a warm blush ground, and the first thing a student sees is how much is done. One committed raspberry carries brand and action; plum appears only when something is finished, so checking off an exercise visibly changes the page: the card itself turns into its plum done row.

Density is relaxed and thumb-first: 44px controls, a full-width check-off button on every open exercise, open work shown in full while finished work folds away, a single narrow reading column for students and a list-plus-form split for trainers. Type is a single family, Figtree, with heavy 800 page headings and bold 700 section and card titles, so hierarchy comes from weight rather than size jumps. Every neutral is tinted from the blush hue; there is no flat grey in the system.

The system deliberately replaces shadcn's stock neutral theme (Geist, near-black primary, hairline flat cards): the components keep their shadcn structure but every token, radius and shadow is restyled.
keyCharacteristics: Warm blush ground, white raised surfaces, plum-ink text and blush-tinted borders.
One raspberry action color; plum reserved exclusively for "done"; brick red for delete, kept visibly apart from the brand.
Figtree throughout; 800 for page headings, 700 for titles, 600 for labels and buttons.
Two corners: about 17px on cards and surfaces, 12px on controls; pills for chips and nav.
Soft, blush-tinted ambient shadows; never hard offsets.
Motion that explains state: the check-off morph, rows that open smoothly, one celebration burst when the last exercise is ticked, entrances that decelerate and exits that are shorter.
Nothing moves under the thumb: once a student starts a video or ticks something, the page order holds still until the next visit.

rules.name: The Plum Means Done Rule
rules.body: Plum (`success*`) marks completion and nothing else: no plum for "save", links, generic success toasts, or decoration. The check-off progress toast is plum because it reports completion, not because an action succeeded. Its scarcity is what makes ticking an exercise feel like progress.

rules.name: The No Grey Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries blush chroma (hue 350). Never introduce a zero-chroma grey; pure white is allowed only for raised surfaces.

rules.name: The Brick Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: Destructive stays on the brick hue (28), never on the raspberry hue, so a delete action can't be mistaken for the primary action.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps by weight (800 / 700 / 600 / 400) over a narrow size range (0.75rem to 1.875rem). The one exception is the Numeral: on the student home the done count outranks the greeting, because progress is the first thing a student should see. Don't add other large sizes or a second family.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse, tinted with the blush shadow color, and offset only downward by a few pixels. Never a hard, zero-blur offset.

dos: Do put every content group on a white surface with the Surface shadow and 1px hairline.
Do keep all touch targets at least 44px tall.
Do use plum only for completion: the progress fill, the done status, done rows, the all-done card, check discs and done counts.
Do show open work in full and fold finished work into a row that can be reopened.
Do keep the layout still once a student is working: freeze ordering on the first play or tick, and move focus to the new control when an element is replaced.
Do tint every new neutral from blush hue 350.
Do use the enter curve for appearing, the exit curve (shorter) for leaving, and the move curve for things changing place.

Do honor reduced motion: the check-off morph, row open/close, progress fill, check zoom, all-done swap and burst ring, toast enter/exit, smooth scrolling, poster and player fades, label fade, chevron turn, play-disc scale and skeleton pulse all switch off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't use plum for generic success, save confirmation or decoration, and don't bring back green for "done".
Don't put destructive actions on the raspberry hue; delete stays brick.
Don't introduce flat greys, near-black primaries, or the stock shadcn neutral theme.
Don't use a second typeface or system display fonts; Figtree carries every role.
Don't use hard, zero-blur offset shadows.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or kicker labels above headings; headings stand alone.
